additional_info.subject: Faulty Charger – No. 312900727028
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
We are experiencing a technical issue with charging station
312900727028
, which stopped communicating with our system on
20/02/2025 at 23:15:20.809
. Despite our troubleshooting efforts, the issue persists.
Issue Details:
Station Location:
[Specify location]
Issue Description:
The last log received from the station was on
20/02/2025 at 23:15:20.109
, with the message:
"PerformingCollaboratedReboot"
.
A technician was dispatched on
23/02/2025
and conducted several tests, including power cycling the
XF4 router
, but the station did not resume communication.
The SIM card was checked and appears to be properly installed.
The XF4 router appears to be malfunctioning, as its indicator lights are not operating correctly (attached image).
Actions Taken (Unsuccessful):
A
Hard Reboot
was performed, but the station
still has not resumed communication
.
Orel from Siemens performed a software update to the latest available version
, but the issue remains unresolved.
Thank you for your prompt support.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinitzer
